name: After § 78
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 78a. Stresses that the transport sector is experiencing substantial challenges in meeting the EU’s climate goals; calls on the Commission, the Council and the Member States to support the development and deployment of sustainable fuels (e-fuels, biofuels) in all transport sectors, and in particular the maritime and aviation sectors;
